subject.title: [BUG] drive list/info ignore pagination; info falsely reports File not found past page 1

question: Should Feishu Drive `info` gain a folder-scoped lookup contract for paginated searches, or should `info` remain root-only while this issue is narrowed to the already-merged list fix?
rationale: The remaining fix changes the user-facing tool contract, and automatic root draining conflicts with the documented Feishu bot credential limitation.

options.title: Add folder-scoped info pagination
options.body: Expose a concrete folder token or equivalent scope for `info`, paginate only inside that folder, and validate it with focused mocked/runtime proof.

options.title: Keep info root-only
options.body: Document that users must page through `list` first and treat `info` as limited to current root behavior.

options.title: Wait for live tenant proof first
options.body: Hold implementation until a maintainer can prove the exact Feishu API behavior with credentials and a multi-page shared folder.

recommendation.title: Add folder-scoped info pagination
recommendation.body: Expose a concrete folder token or equivalent scope for `info`, paginate only inside that folder, and validate it with focused mocked/runtime proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They landed the list half and already framed the remaining folder-aware contract question on the issue.
